plain_text:
Bill Thompson appears in 376 recordings across 8 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1935 to 1956. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Bill Thompson most often in Fibber McGee and Molly, The Phil Harris-Alice Faye Show, CBS Radio Workshop, Wild Bill Hickok, Lux Radio Theatre, The Great Gildersleeve, The Halls of Ivy, and The Lone Ranger.

Characters credited here include Wallace Wimple and The Old Timer.
